title: Constructor impact comparison

result.gainSource: The two DI architecture candidates were found only in the assisted run.
result.fixQualityDifference: Both runs made the same correct one-file fix and passed the same independent check.

limitations: One paired run is only a demonstration; it does not establish a general advantage.
The assisted run did not improve managed-call or test-identification recall; both were already complete in baseline.
The assisted run added three architecture-candidate false positives.
Static DI evidence does not prove runtime container activation.
Baseline ran first; order and cache effects may influence duration and token counts.
Paths and equivalent constructor signatures were normalized as described in the protocol.
excludedHarnessIncident: An initial result schema failed Codex strict JSON validation before any agent work. The schema was corrected and the same corrected schema was used for both measured runs.
